RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning an all-male panel does not support a claim of sex discrimination against you. While an all-male hiring panel may point to broader organizational diversity shortcomings at the broadcaster, raising it to contest your own rejection would undermine your professional credibility.

The stated reason for hiring the other candidate was his strong digital media experience, which is a legitimate merit-based qualification. If you suspect bias, age might be a more plausible factor given the disparity in years of experience, but you currently lack evidence. Your best course of action is to send a polite follow-up requesting your written feedback to understand where your application fell short.
